senses.gloss: मद- + अम्बर मद- + अम्बर, m. an elephant in rut.
मदिरा- + ईक्षण मदिरा- + ईक्षण, f. णा, a fascinating woman, Śāk. d. 67.

मद- + उत्कट मद- + उत्कट,
 I. adj. 1. arrogant. 2. furious.
 II. m. an elephant in rut.
मद- + कल मद- + कल, 1. adj. speaking like a drunken person. 2. m. an elephant in rut; see कला.
मदन- + पाठक मदन- + पाठक, m. the Indian cuckoo.
मदन- + बाध मदन- + बाध, f. pain of love, Vikr. 41, 15.
काम-, मदन- + मञ्जरि काम-, मदन- + मञ्जरि, and राग-मञ्जरी, f. proper names.

1. मद् मद्, ved. i. 1, Par.; i. 4, माद्य, Par. (originally, to be wet).
 1. To get drunk (ved.).
 2. To be glad, to rejoice, Chr. 291, 1 = Rigv. i. 85, 1; MBh. 1, 4688.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मत्ल.
 1. Drunk, a drunkard, Man. 9, 78.
 2. Intoxicated, Hit. iv. d. 55; with love, Ṛt. 6, 14; with pride, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 20.
 3. Mad, Rām. 3, 55, 36; furious, Hit. i. d. 34, M.M.; being in rut (as an elephant), Rām. 3, 52, 46.
 4. Pleased. m.
 1. An elephant in rut.
 2. A buffalo.
 3. The Indian cuckoo.
 4. The thorn apple. f. ता, Vinous liquor.
 --Comp.
 --Caus.
 I. मादय.
 1. To intoxicate.
 2. To exhilarate, MBh. 3, 10678.
 --i. 10, Ātm. To rejoice, Chr. 291, 6 = Rigv. i. 15. 6.
 II. मदय,
 1. To exhilarate. []
 2. To be satisfied, MBh. 1, 4736.
 3. † To doze, to be sluggish.
 --With अनु अनु in अनुमत्त, Cured from insanity, again sane, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 14.
 --With उद् उद्, To be mad, MBh. 3, 14503. उन्मत्त,
 1. Drunk.
 2. Insane, Rām. 3, 55, 8; furious, Hit. ii. d. 116; Utt. Rāmac. 42, 16; a lunatic, Man. 3, 161; Pañc. iii. d. 67. m. The thorn apple.
 --Caus.
 I. मादय, उन्मादित, Caused to be mad, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 16.
 II. मदय, उन्मदित, The same, ib. 191, 18 (read ˚माद्˚).
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To stray from (with abl.).
 2. To be negligent, careless, unguarded, Man. 2, 213.
 --Comp. ptcple. pres. अ-प्रमाद्यन्त्, Being careful, MBh. 12, 3996. प्रमत्त,
 1. Careless, Hit. ii. d. 104.
 2. Intoxicated.
 3. Insane, furious, Chr. 35, 6; being in rut, Pañc. 80, 6.
 4. Addicted to gaming, Man. 9, 78.
 5. Mad with desire, 4, 40.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj. careful, watchful, Pañc. 88, 19.
 --With वि वि, विमत्त, Ruttish, Kir. 5, 47.
 --With सम् सम्, संमत्त, Intoxicated with love, Sund. 4, 17; cf. 12; see मन्द्.
 --Cf. Lat. madidus, madere, manare (for mad + no, denomin.); μαδός, μαδάω, μαδαρός; probably Goth. mats; A.S. maete; Goth. matjan; μασάομαι; Lat. mandere; A.S. maetan, To dream.
2. मद् मद् (or मत्, probably abl. sing. of अमद्), former part of compounds and base of many derivatives, implying the singular of the pronoun of the first person; cf. e. g. मद्-विध, मदिय.

मद 1. मद् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Intoxication, Chr. 292, 10 = Rigv. i. 85, 10; Pañc. 202, 25.
 2. Insanity, Pañc. iv. d. 68; rut of an elephant, 87, 16.
 3. Pride, Hit. i. d. 175, M.M.
 4. Joy, Ṛt. 6, 32; sensual enjoyment, Ṛt. 6, 12.
 5. Passion, Rājat. 5, 214; love, Vikr. 59, 2. []
 6. Spirituous liquor.
 7. The juice that flows from an elephant's temples when in rut, Pañc. i. d. 139.
 8. Semen virile.
 9. Musk.
 II. f. दी.
 1. A drinking vessel.
 2. An instrument for making furrows.
 --Comp.

माद माद, i. e. मद् + अ, m.
 1. Intoxication.
 2. Joy.
 3. Pride.
मदच्युत् मद-च्यु + त्, adj. Yielding intoxication or joy, Chr. 291, 7 = Rigv. i. 85, 7.

मदन 1. मद् + अन,
 I. m.
 1. Love, Vikr. 22, 8; Kāmadeva, the god of love, Vikr. d. 9.
 2. The season of spring.
 3. Thorn apple, Datura metel.
 4. A bee.
 5. Beeswax.
 II. f. न and नी, Spirituous liquor.
 --Comp.

मादन मादन, i. e. मद्, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Delighting.
 2. Cloves.
मदमुच् मद-मुच्, adj. Distilling juice, being in rut (viz. an elephant; cf. मद), Utt. Rāmac. 62, 14.

मदयित्नु मदयित्नु, i. e. मद्, Caus., + इत्नु, m.
 1. A drunken man.
 2. A distiller.
 3. A cloud.
 4. The god of love.
 5. Spirituous liquor.

मदार 1. मद् + आर, m.
 1. An elephant.
 2. A rogue.
 3. A hog.

मदिर 1. मद् + इर,
 I. m. A red species of Khayar, Mimosa catechu.
 II. f. रा.
 1. Spirituous liquor, Man. 11, 148; wine, nectar, Megh. 76.
 2. The wagtail.
मदिराक्षी मदिराक्षी, i. e. मदिरा-अक्ष + ई, f. A (fascinating) woman, Vikr. d. 105.
मदिरेक्षणी मदिरेक्षणी, i. e. मदिरा-ईक्षण + ई, f. A fascinating woman, Vikr. d. 32; Śāk. d. 67.
मदिष्ठा मदिष्ठा, f. of the superl. of मद + वन्त्, Spirituous liquor.
मदीय 2. मद् + ईय, adj. Mine, Pañc. 191, 10.

मद्गु मद्गु, i. e. मज्ज् + उ (see मज्ज्), m.
 1. An aquatic bird, the diver, Lass. 50, 1.
 2. An outcaste, the son of a Brāhmaṇa by a woman of the bard class.
 3. A ship.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. mergus.
मद्गुर मद्गुर, i. e. मज्ज् + उर (see मज्ज्), m. A sort of fish.
मद्य मद् + य, n. Spirituous liquor, wine, Pañc. 35, 15.
माद्य माद्य, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 3. but I prefer correcting मान्द्य.
मद्यप मद्य-प (vb. 1. पा), m. A drinker of intoxicating spirits, Man. 3, 159; a drunkard, Pañc. iv. d. 10.

मद्र मद् + र,
 I. m.
 1. Joy.
 2. The name of a country, Sāv. 1, 2.
 3. A sovereign of that country.
 II. f. रा, The name of a river.
मद्वन् मद् + वन्, m. Śiva.
मादृश् मादृश्, and मादृश मादृश, i. e. 2. मद्-दृश् and दृश् + अ, adj. Like me, Lass. 41, 17 (दृश्); Utt. Rāmac. 42, 15 (श).
माद्रवती माद्रवती, i. e. मद्र + अ + वन्त् + ई, f. The wife of Paṇḍu, and mother of the two youngest Pāṇḍava princes, Draup. 8, 17.
माद्री माद्री, i. e. मद्र + अ + ई, f. The wife of Paṇḍu, and mother of the two youngest Pāṇḍava princes.
माद्रेय माद्रेय, i. e. माद्री + एय, m. A son of Mādrī, i. e. Nakula or Sahadeva, Johns. Sel. 27, 25.
मदन-काकु- + रव मदन-काकु- + रव, m. a pigeon.

मद्- + विध मद्- + विध, adj. such as
 I. Chr. 24, 40; Hit. iii. d. 100.
मद्-बन्धन- + समुद्भव मद्-बन्धन- + समुद्भव, adj. caused by (the binding of me, i. e.) my bondage, Pañc. iii. d. 162.
